notes: Both coders found the same two documents (OAI Fall 2024 deck, OIT interim guidance) and both set stance to delegates. Only-A units (11) were all real statements (e.g. 'Give guidance for every assignment', 'Highlight AI literacy', quoted example permission, equity-and-cost sentence on the interim page) and were kept. Only-B units: two kept (consequence sentence 'may constitute a violation of the University's Academic Integrity Code'; 'Identify when generative AI use offers acceptable opportunities for efficiency'), one dropped (the question 'What is the difference between AI-assistance ... and AI-generated language', a discussion prompt, not a statement).
